findings.mechanism: The post-republish assertion reads the draft via readPreview() instead of the visitor view via readPublic().
findings.consequence: The test can pass even if publishSaved() fails to replace the public snapshot, so it does not verify either public field after republishing.
findings.repro: Use a site where save(newer) updates the preview correctly but publishSaved() is a no-op. This assertion still passes while site.readPublic() remains equal to older.

labels.note: Строка 10: readPreview вместо readPublic; no-op publishSaved оставляет гостю older.

findings.mechanism: Awaiting verify(visitor) outside a try/finally causes control flow to skip visitor.close() when verify rejects.
findings.consequence: An acquired visitor is not closed exactly once on verification failure.
findings.repro: Use a visitor whose close() increments a counter and a verify function that returns Promise.reject(new Error('failed')); after inspect rejects, assert the counter is 1. The candidate leaves it at 0.

labels.note: Строка 3: reject перескакивает close; счётчик вызовов остаётся нулём.

findings.mechanism: The test checks only that clientHeight is positive and never compares scrollHeight with clientHeight.
findings.consequence: A summary whose text extends below the hidden fixed-height box passes even though vertical text is clipped.
findings.repro: Use a summary with clientHeight = 10, scrollHeight = 20, and textContent = 'The venue closes at six.'; verify(summary) passes, but scrollHeight > clientHeight exposes clipping.

labels.note: Строка 5: clientHeight > 0 не исключает scrollHeight > clientHeight; указаны высоты 10/20.

findings.mechanism: The test passes the same `expected` object used by the assertion into `editor.stage`. If `stage` mutates that object, the expected value is mutated too.
findings.consequence: An editor that rewrites either field before publishing can still pass because `published()` is compared against the already-rewritten object.
findings.repro: Use an editor whose `stage(content)` sets `content.heading = 'Rewritten'` and stores it, whose `release()` publishes the stored object, and whose `published()` returns it; `verify` incorrectly succeeds.

labels.note: Строка 6: один объект для stage и эталона; пример с перезаписью heading до release.

findings.mechanism: Awaiting verify outside a try/finally causes control flow to exit immediately when verify rejects, skipping visitor.close().
findings.consequence: An acquired visitor is not closed exactly once on verification failure, and its resources may leak.
findings.repro: Use createVisitor returning { close: async () => { closeCount++; } } and verify as async () => { throw new Error('failure'); }; await inspect(...).catch(() => {}), then assert closeCount === 1. The candidate leaves it at 0.

labels.note: Строка 3: rejected verify завершает функцию до close; предложен счётчик.

findings.mechanism: The post-republish assertion reads the draft via readPreview() instead of the visitor view via readPublic().
findings.consequence: The test can pass even if publishSaved() does not replace the public snapshot, so neither public field is verified after republishing.
findings.repro: Use a site where save(newer) updates preview, publishSaved() is a no-op, and readPublic() remains older; this test passes, while assert.deepEqual(site.readPublic(), newer) would fail.

labels.note: Строка 10: save меняет предпросмотр даже при no-op публикации; показывает отличие от проверки public.

findings.mechanism: The verification checks only that clientHeight is positive and never compares scrollHeight with clientHeight.
findings.consequence: An element whose text is vertically clipped can pass the test.
findings.repro: Call verify({textContent:'The venue closes at six.', clientHeight:10, scrollHeight:20}); it passes even though scrollHeight exceeds clientHeight.

labels.note: Строка 5: показывает положительную видимую высоту при полном DOM-тексте и обрезании.

findings.mechanism: The mutable `expected` object is passed directly to `stage`, allowing the editor to rewrite the same object later used as the assertion oracle.
findings.consequence: If `stage` mutates either field and `published()` returns that mutated content, the deep equality check passes despite incorrect publication.
findings.repro: Use an editor whose `stage(content)` sets `content.heading = 'Rewritten'` and stores it, whose `release()` publishes the stored object, and whose `published()` returns it; `verify` incorrectly passes.

labels.note: Строка 6: мутация входа меняет ожидаемое; воспроизведение сохраняет тот же изменённый объект.

findings.mechanism: The post-republish assertion reads the draft via readPreview() instead of the visitor view via readPublic().
findings.consequence: The test does not verify that publishSaved() replaced the public snapshot or that both public fields now match the saved draft; an implementation that leaves the public snapshot unchanged could pass.
findings.repro: Use a site where publishSaved() is a no-op while save(newer) updates the preview. The assertion passes because readPreview() returns newer, although readPublic() still returns older. Replace this check with assert.deepEqual(site.readPublic(), newer).

labels.note: Строка 10: проверяется новый черновик, а не обновление двух полей публичного снимка.

findings.mechanism: The test passes `expected` directly to `stage` and later uses that same object as the assertion oracle. If `stage` mutates the received object, it also mutates `expected`.
findings.consequence: An editor that rewrites `heading` or `summary` before publishing can incorrectly pass the test because actual and expected contain the same rewritten values.
findings.repro: Use an editor whose `stage(content)` sets `content.heading = 'Rewritten'` and stores it, whose `release()` publishes the stored object, and whose `published()` returns it; `verify` passes instead of failing.

labels.note: Строка 6: общий эталон меняется при записи любого поля; указана проверка с переписанным heading.

findings.mechanism: Awaiting verify before entering any cleanup path means a rejected verification skips the subsequent visitor.close() call.
findings.consequence: An acquired visitor is not closed when async verify rejects, violating the exactly-once cleanup requirement.
findings.repro: Use createVisitor returning { close: async () => { closeCount++; } } and verify as async () => { throw new Error('fail'); }; await inspect(...).catch(() => {}), then assert closeCount === 1. The candidate leaves it at 0.

labels.note: Строка 3: отклонение verify происходит до участка очистки; пример проверяет один вызов вместо нуля.

findings.mechanism: The test checks only that clientHeight is positive and never compares scrollHeight with clientHeight.
findings.consequence: An element whose text extends below its visible inner height and is vertically clipped will incorrectly pass.
findings.repro: Call verify with { textContent: 'The venue closes at six.', clientHeight: 10, scrollHeight: 20 }; it does not throw, although scrollHeight > clientHeight proves vertical clipping.

labels.note: Строка 5: проверка высоты без scrollHeight пропускает строку за видимым краем.
